crime: In the days before, the girl would hold {WITCH_NAME}'s hand in the lounge, offering comfort without a word. {WITCH_NAME} answered through her Magic, keeping snow falling around them throughout their shared silence.

Today, the girl asked her to listen—to keep her company without weather between them. Instead, {WITCH_NAME} conjured a thunderstorm in the lounge, drowning out the girl's voice. With her words lost beneath it, the girl withdrew her hand for the last time.

That afternoon, during free time, a natural hailstorm battered the courtyard. Under its cover, {WITCH_NAME} answered the farewell with a hailstorm of her own inside the lounge. It bombarded the girl until she died. When the natural storm ended, she dragged the body into the courtyard, then draped a blanket over the hail-pitted sofa. In the courtyard, she told the prisoners that the girl had died outside in the storm.

But when a prisoner pulled the blanket away in the lounge, a splinter lodged in the girl's palm matched a break in the exposed sofa. That match overturned {WITCH_NAME}'s story: her fatal hail had struck inside the lounge, not outside in the courtyard.
fields.epitaph: The voice she silenced was the companionship she could never reclaim.
execution: The glass rain cabinet on the execution stand holds her fast in a bolted chair. Artificial rain hammers down, filling the cabinet until the water rises over her face. The downpour continues. She hangs in the chair's restraints, motionless beneath the water.

magic.name: Weather at Will
magic.text: She can conjure any weather she chooses in the air around her.
